threads.body: Please retain `dependsOn(testing.suites)` when all suites belong in `check`, as preferred by `.github/instructions/instrumentation-gradle.instructions.md:175-178`. Enumerating the remaining suites adds a second list to maintain, and adopting `unitTests()` does not require it. Apply the same fix to the other narrowed `check` blocks in Spring JMS 2.0, Spring AI, Lettuce, JMS 1.1, Jedis 2.0, InfluxDB, and Couchbase.

replies.body: Restored `dependsOn(testing.suites)` in all eight modules in 22f151cc8452. The `unitTests()` conversions are unchanged.
